content.short: SnapX is a Telegram trading app for following KOL signals, finding meme coins, and trading quickly.
content.description: SnapX is a Telegram-native trading product focused on signals and fast execution. Its site describes following proven traders, receiving meme-coin alerts, tracking transparent PnL, and trading from Telegram, while TON App listings describe AI-powered DEX trading. The product is better understood as a trading and signal app than as a generic social profile tool. Snapx smart recruiting solutions provide complete staffing solutions for recruiters, job search tools for candidates online resume builder and managers.
